tool.name: read
tool.description: Read the contents of a file. Output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB. Use offset and limit to paginate through large files.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to read.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-based). Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Defaults to all lines.
